title: Eddie Perkin - Battling Biases and Building Better Investment Teams
summary:
Eddie shares how his early experiences
shaped his investment philosophy before examining quality value
investing, behavioral biases, and the importance of process over
outcomes. The conversation explores leadership, collaborative
conflict, confirmation bias, portfolio construction, selling
discipline, and how investment organizations can create
environments that encourage independent thinking. Eddie also
reflects on the future of investing, the opportunities created by
technological change, and the books and ideas that continue to
influence his thinking—and much more!
